record.question: A characteristic feature of protozoa is:
options: They are microscopic and lack cell walls
They are arthropods that feed on humans
record.explanation: Answer A: They are microscopic and lack cell walls. Protozoa are traditionally described as microscopic unicellular eukaryotes without cell walls. It is a broad educational characterization, not an exception-free rule for every organism historically grouped as protozoa. Reference: https://www.cdc.gov/parasites/about/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
